+def _get_fill_value(var, fill_value):
+    """Get the appropriate fill value for a variable."""
+    if fill_value is dtypes.NA:
+        # Use NaN for floating point, or the fill_value for other types
+        if var.dtype.kind == 'f':
+            return np.nan
+        else:
+            return fill_value
+    return fill_value
+
+
+def _create_missing_variable(var, fill_value):
+    """Create a variable filled with fill_value matching the shape and dims of var."""
+    fill_val = _get_fill_value(var, fill_value)
+    data = np.full(var.shape, fill_val, dtype=var.dtype)
+    return Variable(var.dims, data, attrs=var.attrs, encoding=var.encoding)
+
